subject: CAIQ scope interlock protocol and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@greenfieldbank.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Cc: security-team@greenfieldbank.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ scope clarifications and evidence handoff

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the call earlier. We reviewed the initial CAIQ crosswalk you sent and have two things to clarify before we pass to our internal compliance reviewers:

1) Scope: we need confirmation that the CAIQ controls mapped to the "Private Deployment (VPC)" topology explicitly exclude the hosted telemetry collectors you mentioned — please confirm which services are in-scope for the bank.
2) Evidence types: our auditors expect file-level log samples where a control references "runtime telemetry"; will you be able to provide redacted log snippets and a short explanation of the log retention policy?

If you can share a concise handoff package (mapping + sample artifacts) by end of week, we can advance to a formal review.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Cloud Risk
Greenfield Bank

--
Attachment: initial_audit_questions.pdf (pdf stub)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.example
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@greenfieldbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, kimberly_park@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope clarifications and evidence handoff

Elena —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Short answers up front, then a plan:

- Scope: confirmed. For Greenfield Bank's CAIQ submission we'll scope to the Private Deployment topology only (customer-managed VPC + private control plane). Hosted telemetry collectors (hosted API ingestion endpoints) are out-of-scope for this submission; we will mark them as out-of-scope in the crosswalk with a rationale.

- Evidence: we can provide:
  * Redacted runtime log snippets showing request timestamps, operation codes, and anonymized tenant ids (we will redact any PII).
  * A retention-summary PDF that explains rolling retention windows and the policy for archived snapshots.
  * A sampling manifest explaining how logs were selected (time windows, sampling ratio).

Plan and asks:
1) Marissa / Kim — I'm attaching a trimmed CAIQ mapping workbook (sheet: Greenfield_scope) and a short retention exception note. Can you prepare:
   - redacted log snippets (2-3 examples) with a brief readme for auditors;
   - a one-page narrative that ties each sample to the CAIQ control ID (e.g., CC-01, CC-04).
2) Elena — once we have the package (spreadsheet + samples + narrative) I'll upload to the secure Drive link and share a DocuSign acknowledgement for the evidence transfer.

Target: package to you by end-of-day Thursday (2028-06-22) so your reviewers can intake next week. If that's aggressive for your team, we can shift one business day.

Jonas Weber
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: CAIQ_scope_interlock_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), retention-exception-notes.pdf (pdf)

Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope clarifications and evidence handoff

Jonas / Kim —

I'll take the artifacts. Quick status:

- Redacted logs: I'll pull three 5-line snippets from our private-deploy log store (window: 2028-05-01 02:00 UTC to 2028-05-01 03:00 UTC) and scrub tenant identifiers to the hashed id format we standardize on.
- Narrative: I'll map each snippet to the specific CAIQ control it demonstrates (short bullets, two lines each).
- Sampling manifest: will include the query used, sampling ratio (1:100), and the rationale for the time window.

Open question for legal/ops: there's one control (RD-07) that references retention beyond our default window; Greenfield is requesting a residency/retention exception for a subset of telemetry in jurisdiction X. Kim, can you confirm the process for documenting an exception (DocuSign + internal exception log)?

I'll aim to drop the files into the Drive folder Jonas shared by end of day Thursday PST.

-Marissa
Sr. Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

--

From: kimberly_park@redwood.example

Cc: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@greenfieldbank.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope clarifications and evidence handoff

Marissa / team —

Process for retention exception (short):

1) Customer request received (email + CAIQ crosswalk) —> create an Exception ticket in our internal Compliance Log (TICKET-EX-XXXX).
2) Legal review — we draft a one-page exception agreement that captures the scope, duration, and data handling constraints (e.g., encryption at rest, residency).
3) DocuSign acknowledgement from customer — we include the signature as part of the CAIQ submission artifacts.
4) Operational uplift (if required) — engineering implements any residency routing and we snapshot proof (configuration + test logs).

I've created the ticket TICKET-EX-7824 and uploaded a redaction example screenshot; final step: Elena — can you confirm Greenfield is willing to sign the one-page exception (I'll attach a DocuSign link) and confirm the residency window (30 / 90 / custom)?

Rishi: please prepare a short configuration snapshot and a sample ephemeral key rotation log (for the operational uplift step) — two small artifacts we can include if Greenfield agrees to the exception.

Kimberly Park
Compliance Counsel
Redwood Inference

--
